precision: float32 inference, float16 feature storage (roundoff recorded)

method.anchors: Every20 tenHz observations; reset atfirst observation strictlyafter finalpositivePTS in eachfixed single-head editinterval. Pending initial/cut anchors wait fornext source-valid SAM2 frame; missingregular refresh keeps existingtracker and isreported.
method.models: Released Cutiebase-mega480shortside, pretrained DINOv2S14 + randomseed17, no weight substitutions.
method.SAM_replay: Same source frames/boxes/SAM2 config as old cache; verify per-frame Rich96 against storedfloat16, maxabs<=.0005 before accepting.
method.H2controls: Fixedheldanchor;1second delayed Cutie mask, unavailable first10frames; historicalboxcache retained; fixed Farneback160x90 backwardflow and1second delayedflow agreement are secondary consistency, not accuracy.
method.H3features: 4x4grid backgroundHS72+meanS+chromatic occupancy+retained fraction; DINOwholeframe224x224 official normalization pooled4x4, fullforeground context retained as explicitly specified. No feature-model training or PCA yet.
method.missingness: Zero placeholders have explicit validity; no imputation of missing SAM frames. H2 tracker may predict on such frames and availability is separately recorded; manual scoring must not discard prediction failures.
method.PCA_boundary: Cache raw features for all122 families; no PCA or normalization fit here. Later PCA fits only91TRAIN and freezes its transforms before DEV application.
